title: K's DARK GUI - Basic
description: Simple plain, square texture pack, but DARK vanilla
body:
# Description ![k's dark gui title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b65864666cd2fd198936974b3bb42274e6d7545.png)  [](https://www.curseforge.com/members/kentapainter/projects)[](https://discord.gg/C47W2vcKX)[![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fccff83117ceafa3edab37b402e3aee8f1927077.png)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ks-dark-gui) A container GUI replacement pack that hopes to match the menu to every one of Minecraft's interactable blocks. This texture pack will replace the GUI of every block like the crafting table. Each new menu will take inspiration from the bedrock GUI and few texturepacks on internet.

optigui (WIP) or optifine (WIP)

![brief explanation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65b65ba34c45d7e1d9b14ccc3da9e2ad25a950d0.png)            colored shulkerboxes                  each villager professions # GUI's I created all the base Minecraft interfaces; you can check the gallery to get an idea. * Hotbar * Icons * Achievements * Menus * Creative Inventory * All Vanilla # Compatibility Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21 through 26 is supported. Optional: Optifine or optigui (WIP)

![bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00a31c202121a50cf0f41fb64138c51021c733fd.webp)
If you liked the texture and play with mods, you can visit a version that's ready for mod packs, click below.


![bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00a31c202121a50cf0f41fb64138c51021c733fd.webp) # FAQ

-Why are some textures change o looks odd?
Maybe you have Optifine or OptiGUI installed. Some textures like villagers and shulker GUI’s only work with OptiGUI and Optifine, but I changed my mind halfway through and stopped making those colorful versions, opting for a dark theme. also had problems with OptiFine while working on version 1.21.1, but I never touched it again, preferring to include mods.

-Can I add your packs to my modpack?
Yes, you can add any of my resource packs to your Modrinth or Curseforge modpacks if you give me proper credits and add my pack as a dependent.

-Where can i post suggestions for either mod support or other things?
I'll think about it in the future, maybe Discord. Meanwhile, comments.

-Something isn't working properly or I have a question.
What can I tell you...
